response.justification: The candidate is an experienced and versatile senior engineer, but the profile does not match the core requirements of this role. C++ exposure is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments (2014–2015) and a university thesis project, far short of the 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ development required. There is no fixed income, derivatives, or investment-banking systems experience (RIDE Capital is a retail investment fintech built on Node/TypeScript, not capital markets infrastructure), and no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle work — database experience is MongoDB and MySQL. The strengths in TypeScript, DLang, testing practices, and CI/CD do not compensate for the absence of all three mandatory criteria.
strengths: Broad senior-level engineering experience across many stacks and domains
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, pairing, trunk-based development
Low-latency, high-throughput systems work at Sociomantic/dunnhumby
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ experience, none recent
No fixed income, derivatives, or investment-banking domain exposure
No SQL Server/Oracle or Windows-platform development background
